finalText:
Build's clean (exit 0) now. The remaining ~950 lines of DEP0xxx/W1xxx-style output are genuine noise (bundler's own deprecation chatter), but two real bugs from the bump were hiding in there:

- `src/core/options.js` — still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `{ retryCount }`. This threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')` and aborted the build.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but the check only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else.

Fixed both to match the new shapes; build now finishes with 0 errors.
